title: Handle webhook duplicates and ambiguous external effects
prompt: A payment webhook arrives twice concurrently. A remote charge may succeed before the local process crashes. Explain the event record, acknowledgment, and recovery strategy. Respond in a few concise lines; do not modify files.
rubric: The answer uses durable provider-scoped event identity and a uniqueness constraint with atomic claiming.
It distinguishes completed, in-progress and failed processing and acknowledges only according to the provider retry contract.
It uses a stable provider idempotency key or reconciliation for ambiguous external effects and does not claim a local transaction guarantees exactly once.
acceptance: The response satisfies the listed behavioral requirements and makes no changes.
